verdict.rationale: Restate is a durable-execution platform, so a built-in AI layer that analyzes your invocations or state is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence shows only adjacent features: primitives for building your own AI agents, a coding-agent plugin that teaches assistants to write Restate apps, non-AI introspection tools, and a third-party Langfuse integration. None of these is a product-native feature that generates insights or suggestions from the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
